remotes.title: Magic Remote MR25GA
sources: OLED48C56LB, webOS 10.3.0, 17 November 2026: CH+ and CH- received by the key filter

OLED48C56LB, webOS 10.3.0, 21 November 2026: every key but Power pressed and read from the remote's input device (LGE M-RCU - Builtin [0]): Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, LG Channels, Alexa, the key in Sling TV's place (sent as IR_KEY_RAKUTENTV), CH+ and CH-, Guide, the house in a circle (IR_KEY_INPUT_HUB), ? (IR_KEY_MULTIKEY, held as the same code), and the AI key (RF_KEY_VOICE, the microphone's code); also Home, Back, Settings, 123, the arrows, the wheel and volume, which the Remote tab does not offer
OLED48C56LB, webOS 10.3.0, 22 November 2026: the TV reports the remote as LGE MR25GA in its Bluetooth device list, its pairing file and lginput2's press log; the remote's label says MR25GA
The AI key as its own key (ai) is from webOS 11's native mapping; on webOS 10 it arrives as the microphone key (voice), so the Remote tab names that key AI for this remote
No number keys, no red, green, yellow or blue keys, and no Info or Input key
remotes.notes: Every button on the remote was pressed except Power, and the owner confirmed on 22 November 2026 that the list is every button it has.

remotes.title: Magic Remote MR23
sources: OLED48C31LA, webOS 11.2.0, 25 November 2026: the remote paired with the TV, reported by the TV as LGE MR23, read from lginput2's NL_BUTTON_CLICK and NL_NON_LIST_BUTTON_CLICK lines in /var/log/messages, pressed one at a time: Netflix (KEY_NETFLIX), Prime Video (KEY_AMAZON), Disney+ (KEY_DISNEY), LG Channels (KEY_LGCHANNELS), Rakuten TV (KEY_RAKUTEN), Alexa (KEY_ALEXAVOICE), channel up and down (KEY_CHANNELUP, KEY_CHANNELDOWN), Guide (KEY_GUIDE), the microphone (KEY_VOICE), Input (KEY_INPUT), the … button under which AD/SAP is printed (KEY_SCREEN_REMOTE), a number key (KEY_5) and Red (KEY_RED); also Home (KEY_HOME, not Home Hub), Back (KEY_PREVIOUS) and OK, which the Remote tab does not offer

The owner confirmed on 25 November 2026 that the remote has no Home Hub (house in a circle) button, no ? button, no Apps, Movies or Info key, and that green, yellow and blue are printed beside the measured Red key
As for the MR25GA: the microphone arrives as the AI key (ai) on webOS 11's native mapping, which does not depend on the remote's model, rather than the microphone key (voice) that lginput2 logs
remotes.notes: Every Remote tab key the owner could identify was pressed and read from the log; green, yellow and blue were not pressed individually, assumed from Red and the owner's own account of the remote's layout.
